summary:
1 US Domestic Oil Production, by Source
The export debate rambles on As US domestic crude oil production continues to grow, so does the speculation of whether or not exports will be permitted. Since domestically produced crude oil tends to be of the lighter/sweeter variety and the penchant of the US refining complex is for heavy/sour crude, it stands to reason that we are structurally long the wrong grade. To those in the know, the qualities of each crude oil grade prevent it from being a truly fungible commodity - a fact that seemingly continues to escape most politicians.
